scope: Actual isolated Docker runc on the existing Linux preparation host; no production API changes, no downloads during tasks, not a container escape proof.

checks.name: OCaml list fold and sum
checks.code:
let values = List.init 10 (fun i -> i + 1)
let () = Printf.printf "%d\n" (List.fold_left (+) 0 values)

checks.name: OCaml algebraic type and pattern matching
OCaml multiline UTF-8 stdin
checks.code: let () = for _i = 1 to 2 do Printf.printf "[%s]\n" (read_line ()) done
